evals.expected_output: Releases the existing 0.1.0 without bumping; creates CHANGELOG.md (Keep a Changelog, user-facing entries); commits and tags v0.1.0 locally; runs the zero-warning checks and cargo publish --dry-run; does not push, publish or create a GitHub release; reports clearly that nothing left the machine.

Nothing pushed to origin (no new commits or tags)
